# Setup

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(tidySingleCellExperiment)
library(MoleculeExperiment)
library(cytomapper)
library(SpatialExperiment)

library(sf)
library(raster)
library(terra)
library(cytomapper)
library(lisaClust)

library(edgeR)
library(limma)
library(gghighlight)
library(Statial)
library(lisaClust)
```

```{r}
E8_imc = readRDS("data/E8_imc.rds")
E8_xenium = readRDS("data/E8_xenium.rds")


zeroCells = colnames(E8_imc)[!colnames(E8_imc) %in%  colnames(E8_xenium)]

E8_imc |> 
  filter(.cell %in% zeroCells) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = x, y =y, col = cellTypeProtein)) +
  geom_point() +
  theme_classic()


E8_imc |> 
 mutate(isZero = ifelse(.cell %in% zeroCells, "yes", "no")) |> 
  arrange(isZero) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = x, y =y, col = isZero)) +
  geom_point() +
  theme_classic()

E8_imc = E8_imc |> 
  filter(!.cell %in% zeroCells)


all(colnames(E8_imc) == colnames(E8_xenium))

E8_xenium$cellTypeProtein = E8_imc$cellTypeProtein
E8_imc$cellTypeTranscript = E8_xenium$cellTypeTranscript
```



```{r}


clusterMarkers = c(
  "CD11c",
  # "CD16", # Myeloid marker
  "CD68",
  #"panCK", # Epithelial cells, not really expected in E8
  "CD20",
  "CD8a",
  "podoplanin",
  "CD14",
  "FX111A",
  # "FoxP3", # CD4 transcript marker, not very highly expressed
  "CD45",
  "CD66a",
  "CD3",
  "anti-cy5", #SOX10 tumour marker
  "HLADR",
  "CD4",
  # "CD56",
  "CD31"
)


scater::plotGroupedHeatmap(
  E8_imc,
  features = clusterMarkers,
  group = "cellTypeProtein",
  exprs_values = "norm",
  center = TRUE,
  scale = TRUE,
  zlim = c(-3, 3),
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  block = "cellTypeProtein"
) 

```

# Boxplots comparing genes

```{r fig.height= 10}

useMarkers = rownames(E8_imc)[!(rownames(E8_imc) %in% c("80ArAr", "104Pd", "HH3", "189Os", "190Os", "DNA1", "DNA2", "208Pb"))]

E8_imc_long = E8_imc |> 
  join_features(useMarkers, shape = "long")


E8_imc_long |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = cellTypeProtein, y = .abundance_norm)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  theme_classic() + 
  facet_wrap(~.feature)+ 
  coord_flip()
```

Final figure:
```{r}

imc <- join_features(E8_imc, features = "CD3", shape = "wide") |> colData() |> as.data.frame() 
xenium <- join_features(E8_xenium, features = "CD3E", shape = "wide", assay = "transcript_counts") |> colData() |> as.data.frame()

combine <- full_join(imc,xenium)

combine$CD3E <- factor(pmin(combine$CD3E,3), levels = c(0,1,2,3), labels = c(0,1,2,"3+"))

c1 <- cor(combine$CD3, as.numeric(combine$CD3E), use = "complete")


```

```{r}

pCD3 <- combine |>
  na.omit() |>
ggplot(aes(CD3E, CD3)) +
geom_violin(quantile.linetype = 1, quantile.linewidth = c(0.25,1.25,0.25), width = 0.8) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(title = paste0("CD3 vs CD3E (r = ", round(c1,2), ")")) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))

```

```{r}

imc <- join_features(E8_imc, features = "CD20", shape = "wide") |> colData() |> as.data.frame() 
xenium <- join_features(E8_xenium, features = "MS4A1", shape = "wide", assay = "transcript_counts") |> colData() |> as.data.frame()

combine <- full_join(imc,xenium)

combine$MS4A1 <- factor(pmin(combine$MS4A1,3), levels = c(0,1,2,3), labels = c(0,1,2,"3+"))

c2 <- cor(combine$CD20, as.numeric(combine$MS4A1), use = "complete")

```


# Mask Visualisation

## FINAL - Using Thresholds
```{r fig.height = 10}
E8Mask_cyto = readRDS("E8_raw/E8Mask_cyto.rds")

# Using cellTypeProtein B cells as CD20 positive
E8_bcell_vis = E8_imc |>
  join_features(c("CD3", "CD20"), shape = "wide", assay = "norm") |> 
  mutate(CD20_pos = ifelse(CD3 < 0.4 & CD20 > 0.065, 1, 0),
         CD3_pos = ifelse(CD3 > 0.4 & CD20 < 0.065, 1, 0),
         MS4A1_pos = ifelse(.cell %in% names(which(assay(E8_xenium, "transcript_counts")["MS4A1",] > 0 &
                                                   assay(E8_xenium, "transcript_counts")["CD3E",] == 0)), 1, 0),
         CD3t_pos = ifelse(.cell %in% names(which(assay(E8_xenium, "transcript_counts")["CD3E",] > 0 &
                                                  assay(E8_xenium, "transcript_counts")["MS4A1",] == 0)) , 1, 0)) |> 
  mutate(bcell_pos = case_when(
    MS4A1_pos == 1 & CD20_pos == 0 ~ "transcript",
    MS4A1_pos == 0 & CD20_pos == 1 ~ "protein",
    MS4A1_pos == 1 & CD20_pos == 1 ~ "both",
    TRUE ~ "none"
  )) |> 
  mutate(cd3pos = case_when(
    CD3t_pos == 1 & CD3_pos == 0 ~ "transcript",
    CD3t_pos == 0 & CD3_pos == 1 ~ "protein",
    CD3t_pos == 1 & CD3_pos == 1 ~ "both",
    TRUE ~ "none"
  ))
  
which(assay(E8_xenium, "transcript_counts")["CD3E",] > 0 & assay(E8_xenium, "transcript_counts")["MS4A1",] > 0) |> 
  length()
plotCells(mask = E8Mask_cyto,
          object = E8_bcell_vis,
          img_id = "imageID",
          cell_id = "imageCellID",
          exprs_values = "norm",
          colour_by = "bcell_pos")


plotCells(mask = E8Mask_cyto,
          object = E8_bcell_vis,
          img_id = "imageID",
          cell_id = "imageCellID",
          exprs_values = "norm",
          colour_by = "cd3pos")

```


```{r}
bcellIDX = which(E8_bcell_vis$CD20_pos == 1)
  
  
ggplot(E8_bcell_vis[, bcellIDX],
       aes(x = assay(E8_imc, "norm")["CD20" , bcellIDX], 
           y =  assay(E8_xenium, "transcript_counts")["MS4A1" , bcellIDX])) +
  geom_point() +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(y = "transcript", x =  "protein")


ggplot(E8_bcell_vis[, bcellIDX],
       aes(x =  as.factor(pmin(assay(E8_xenium, "transcript_counts")["MS4A1" , bcellIDX], 10)),
           y = assay(E8_imc, "norm")["CD20" , bcellIDX])) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(x = "transcript", y =  "protein")
```

## Using imc cellType annotations

```{r}
all(colnames(E8_imc) == colnames(E8_xenium) )
```



```{r}

# Using cellTypeProtein B cells as CD20 positive
E8_bcell_vis = E8_imc |>
  join_features(c("CD3", "CD20"), shape = "wide", assay = "norm") |> 
  mutate(MS4A1_pos = ifelse(.cell %in% names(which(assay(E8_xenium, "transcript_counts")["MS4A1",] >2)), 1, 0),
         CD3t_pos = ifelse(.cell %in% names(which(assay(E8_xenium, "transcript_counts")["CD3E",] > 3)) , 1, 0)) |> 
  mutate(bcell_pos = case_when(
    MS4A1_pos == 1 & cellTypeProtein != "b" ~ "transcript",
    MS4A1_pos == 0 & cellTypeProtein == "b" ~ "protein",
    MS4A1_pos == 1 & cellTypeProtein == "b" ~ "both",
    TRUE ~ "none"
  )) |> 
  mutate(cd3pos = case_when(
    CD3t_pos == 1 &  !cellTypeProtein %in% c("cd8t", "cd4t") ~ "transcript",
    CD3t_pos == 0 &  cellTypeProtein %in% c("cd8t", "cd4t") ~ "protein",
    CD3t_pos == 1 &  cellTypeProtein %in% c("cd8t", "cd4t") ~ "both",
    TRUE ~ "none"
  ))


plotCells(mask = E8Mask_cyto,
          object = E8_bcell_vis,
          img_id = "imageID",
          cell_id = "imageCellID",
          exprs_values = "norm",
          colour_by = "bcell_pos")


plotCells(mask = E8Mask_cyto,
          object = E8_bcell_vis,
          img_id = "imageID",
          cell_id = "imageCellID",
          exprs_values = "norm",
          colour_by = "cd3pos")


E8_bcell_vis$CD3t_pos |> table()


E8_bcell_vis |> 
  filter(CD3t_pos == 1) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = x, y=y, col = cellTypeProtein)) +
  geom_point()

E8_bcell_vis |> 
  filter(cellTypeProtein %in% c("cd4t", "cd8t"))
```

```{r}
    cellTypeTranscript %in% c("tcell", "cd4t", "cd8t") &  cellTypeProtein %in% c("cd8t", "cd4t") ~ "both",
```

# Region analysis


```{r}
set.seed(101)
E8_imc = lisaClust(E8_imc, k = 4, cellType = "cellTypeProtein", regionName = "regionProtein")


# Protein region maps
lisaClust::regionMap(E8_imc, cellType = "cellTypeProtein", region = "regionProtein")

E8_imc |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = x, y = y, col = regionProtein)) +
  geom_point() +
  theme_classic()

all(colnames(E8_imc) == colnames(E8_xenium))

E8_xenium$regionProtein = E8_imc$regionProtein


```


## DE analysis


### T cells 
```{r}

tumour_xenium = E8_xenium |>
  mutate(inTumour = ifelse(regionProtein == "region_4", 1, 0 ))


tcell_transcripts = tumour_xenium |> 
  filter(cellTypeTranscript %in% c("cd4t", "cd8t", "tcell"))

tcell_protein = tumour_xenium |> 
  filter(cellTypeProtein %in% c("cd4t", "cd8t"))



tcell_transcript_fit = limma::lmFit(
  assay(tcell_transcripts, "logcounts"),
  model.matrix(~tcell_transcripts$inTumour)) |> 
  eBayes() |> 
  topTable(number = length(rownames(tumour_xenium)))


tcell_protein_fit = limma::lmFit(
  assay(tcell_protein, "logcounts"),
  model.matrix(~tcell_protein$inTumour)) |> 
  eBayes() |> 
  topTable(number = length(rownames(tumour_xenium)))




tcell_transcript_fit |> 
  rownames_to_column("genes") |> 
  ggplot(aes(logFC,-log10(P.Value)))+
    geom_point(aes(colour=-log10(P.Value)), size=1) +
    scale_colour_gradient(low="blue",high="red")+
    xlab("log2 fold change") + ylab("-log10 p-value") +
    gghighlight(-log10(P.Value) > 5 & abs(logFC) > 0.05, label_key = genes) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(title = "Transcript T cell DE")

tcell_protein_fit |> 
  rownames_to_column("genes") |> 
  ggplot(aes(logFC,-log10(P.Value)))+
    geom_point(aes(colour=-log10(P.Value)), size=1) +
    scale_colour_gradient(low="blue",high="red")+
    xlab("log2 fold change") + ylab("-log10 p-value") +
    gghighlight(-log10(P.Value) > 5 & abs(logFC) > 0.05, label_key = genes) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(title = "Protein T cell DE")


tcell_transcript_fit 



p = tcell_transcript_fit |> 
  rownames_to_column("genes") |> 
  left_join(rownames_to_column(tcell_protein_fit, "genes"),  join_by("genes")) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = t.x, y = t.y, text = genes)) +
  geom_point() +
  labs(x = "Xenium t statistic", y = "IMC t statistic") +
  gghighlight(genes %in% c("AIF1"), label_key = genes) +
  theme_classic()



data = tcell_transcript_fit |> 
  rownames_to_column("genes") |> 
  left_join(rownames_to_column(tcell_protein_fit, "genes"),  join_by("genes")) |> 
  mutate(xenium = abs(t.x) > abs(t.y)) 
  
  
ggplot(data, aes(x = t.x, y = t.y, col = xenium)) +
  geom_point() +
  labs(x = "Xenium t statistic", y = "IMC t statistic", title = "Comparing test statistics for T cell DE") +
   geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, lty = "dashed", col = "red", alpha = 0.5) +
  gghighlight(abs(t.x - t.y) > 2.5 & (t.x < -1 | t.x >1) & (t.y < -1 | t.y >1) , label_key = genes) +
  theme_classic()


ggplot(data, aes(x = t.x, y = t.y, col = xenium)) +
  geom_point() +
  labs(x = "Xenium t statistic", y = "IMC t statistic", title = "Comparing test statistics for T cell DE") +
   geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, lty = "dashed", col = "red", alpha = 0.5) +
  gghighlight(abs(t.x - t.y) > 2.5 & (P.Value.x < 0.05 | P.Value.y < 0.05) , label_key = genes,  label_params =  list(max.overlaps = Inf)) +
  theme_classic()


plotly::ggplotly(p)

plot(tcell_transcript_fit$t, tcell_protein_fit[rownames(tcell_transcript_fit), "t"])

```

### T cell subset genes

```{r}

tcell_genes = c("CD8A", "CD4", "CD3D", "CD3E", "CD247", "TRAC", "GZMB", "GZMK", "GZMA", "PRF1", "NKG7", "CD69", "CCL5", "IL7R", "CD28", "HAVCR2", "PDCD1", "LAG3", "CTLA4", "MKI67", "BCL2L11", "FOXP3", "IL2RA", "SELL", "FGL2")

tcell_transcript_fit = limma::lmFit(
  assay(tcell_transcripts, "logcounts")[tcell_genes, ],
  model.matrix(~tcell_transcripts$inTumour)) |> 
  eBayes() |> 
  topTable(number = length(tcell_genes))


tcell_protein_fit = limma::lmFit(
  assay(tcell_protein, "logcounts")[tcell_genes, ],
  model.matrix(~tcell_protein$inTumour)) |> 
  eBayes() |> 
  topTable(number = length(tcell_genes))


tcell_transcript_fit |> 
  rownames_to_column("genes") |> 
  ggplot(aes(logFC,-log10(P.Value)))+
    geom_point(aes(colour=-log10(P.Value)), size=1) +
    scale_colour_gradient(low="blue",high="red")+
    xlab("log2 fold change") + ylab("-log10 p-value") +
    gghighlight(-log10(P.Value) > 3 & abs(logFC) > 0.05, label_key = genes) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(title = "Transcript T cell DE (T cell genes)")

tcell_protein_fit |> 
  rownames_to_column("genes") |> 
  ggplot(aes(logFC,-log10(P.Value)))+
    geom_point(aes(colour=-log10(P.Value)), size=1) +
    scale_colour_gradient(low="blue",high="red")+
    xlab("log2 fold change") + ylab("-log10 p-value") +
    gghighlight(-log10(P.Value) >3 & abs(logFC) > 0.05, label_key = genes) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(title = "Protein T cell DE (T cell genes)")

```

## T cell in and out of tumour heatmap
```{r fig.height=6, dpi = 300}


tcell_genes = c( "FOXP3", "GZMB", "LAG3",  "PDCD1", "MKI67", "CD3E")



Xenium_heatmapData = E8_xenium |>
  mutate(tcellTechnologies = case_when(
    cellTypeTranscript %in% c("cd8t", "cd4t", "tcell") & cellTypeProtein %in% c("cd8t", "cd4t") ~ "both",
     cellTypeTranscript %in% c("cd8t", "cd4t", "tcell") & !(cellTypeProtein %in% c("cd8t", "cd4t")) ~ "xenium",
     !(cellTypeTranscript %in% c("cd8t", "cd4t", "tcell")) & (cellTypeProtein %in% c("cd8t", "cd4t")) ~ "imc",
    TRUE ~ "other"
  )) |> 
  filter(tcellTechnologies != "other") |> 
  mutate(Location = ifelse(regionProtein == "region_4", "Inside tumour", "Outside Tumour") ) |> 
  mutate(tcellTechnologiesTumour = ifelse(regionProtein == "region_4", paste(tcellTechnologies, "inTumour", sep = "_"), paste(tcellTechnologies, "outTumour", sep = "_") )) 


Xenium_annotation = Xenium_heatmapData |> 
  dplyr::select(tcellTechnologies, tcellTechnologiesTumour, Location) |> 
  data.frame() |> 
  unique() |> 
  rownames_to_column("rowname") |> 
  dplyr::select(-rowname) |> 
  column_to_rownames("tcellTechnologiesTumour") |> 
  rename("") |> 
  mutate(`T cell labelled by IMC` = ifelse(tcellTechnologies %in% c("imc", "both"), "TRUE", "FALSE"),
         `T cell labelled by Xenium` = ifelse(tcellTechnologies %in% c("xenium", "both"), "TRUE", "FALSE")) |> 
  select(-tcellTechnologies) |> 
  mutate(Location = as.factor(Location)) |> 
  relocate(Location, .after = last_col())


Xenium_heatmap = scater::plotGroupedHeatmap(
  Xenium_heatmapData,
  features = tcell_genes,
  group = "tcellTechnologiesTumour",
  exprs_values = "logcounts",
  center = TRUE,
  scale = TRUE,
  zlim = c(-3, 3),
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  cluster_cols = FALSE,
  block = "tcellTechnologiesTumour",
  fontsize_row  = 10,
  label_col = FALSE,
  annotation_col = Xenium_annotation,
  labels_col = ""
) 



ggsave("Tcell_heatmap_transcripts.pdf", plot = Xenium_heatmap, height = 7, width = 8)
```
